IT'S OFFICIALLY ON MY SCOTTSDALE BUCKET LIST! I cannot wait to go! Here are the details you need to know! 

As someone who loves discovering Scottsdale's newest restaurants, I'm especially excited to experience Wolf by Vanderpump at Caesars Republic in Old Town Scottsdale.

If you've followed Lisa Vanderpump over the years, you already know she has a talent for creating spaces that are as memorable as the food—and from everything I've seen, Wolf looks absolutely stunning.

Located on the 7th floor of Caesars Republic Scottsdale, the restaurant offers sweeping views of Camelback Mountain, dramatic interiors, handcrafted cocktails, and a globally inspired menu featuring everything from the famous Goat Cheese Balls and Lobster Ceviche Crisps to Wagyu Sliders, fresh seafood, steaks, salmon, and decadent desserts. 

It's designed for sharing, making it perfect for date nights, girls' nights, or celebrating a special occasion. 

What are people saying?

Overall reviews have been very positive, with diners giving it a 4.4-star rating on OpenTable. 

Guests consistently rave about the incredible ambiance, creative cocktails, rooftop views, and attentive service. 

The Goat Cheese Balls, Wagyu Sliders, Lobster Ceviche Crisps, Camelback Mac & Cheese, steaks, and signature cocktails seem to be among the crowd favorites. 

Some reviewers mention it can get energetic and loud during peak evening hours, so the experience is definitely more vibrant than intimate. 

A few tips before you go:

• Make reservations well in advance, especially for Thursday through Saturday evenings.
• For the best experience, request a table about 30–45 minutes before sunset. You'll enjoy the daylight views, an incredible Arizona sunset, and the city lights after dark.
• Looking for a quieter experience? Weekday lunch or an early dinner is your best bet.
• Lunch is served daily from 11:00 AM–3:00 PM, followed by a Wolf Lounge menu from 3:00–4:00 PM, then dinner begins at 4:00 PM. 

Website: https://www.wolfbyvanderpumpscottsdale.com

findings.snippet:
If you choose one restaurant, I implore you to let it be this one. And no, I am not talking about just 2026.

This Italian-inspired steakhouse is newly renovated and impeccably gorgeous. Comfortable, elevated, modern and artistically beautiful. 

Their newly imagined menu is exciting and varied in all of the best ways. And, they have also kept old classics for their valued and ongoing original patrons. 

It is rare that I dine at a restaurant where there is not room for improvement in one area or another. This particular Scottsdale restaurant dining experience truly stood above the rest. Even when I try to find the failings, I cannot. 

The food was perfectly executed, balanced, tasted incredible and presented in ways that were fun, exciting and creative.

The service was unmatched. Every need anticipated and attended to.

Our server Sunny was an absolute delight and aptly named! Charisma, charm and kindness. Elevated our dining experience to the next level and made us feel comfortable and cared for.

We asked to speak with the manager to share about our experience. Kevin was personable, witty and clearly a master at his craft. As lifelong hospitality pioneer, it is clear why his restaurant is a cut above the rest. 

Some menu highlights:

• Steak tartare topped with a perfectly cured egg yolk. Best I have ever had. 

• Scallop crudo was fresh, bright with the perfect pop of citrus and spice. 

• Table-side mozzarella cart. Perfectly prepared, deep rich umami with the perfect chew. 

• Wagyu stuffed tortellini. Homemade pasta, perfect amount of filling, decadent wagyu and dreamy rich sauce. The perfect bite. 

• Steak frittes, excellent quality steak, perfectly cooked.
